name.ja: HG 1/72 ビッグトニー(ガガンバー・メメンプー機)

description.ja: 冒険メカアクション『サクガン』より「ビッグトニー」がHG 1/72モデルで登場！
description.en: "Big Tony " from the adventure mecha action " Sakugan" is now available as an HG 1/72 Model!

description.ja: ■幅広い可動域でビッグトニーのコミカルかつスタイリッシュな動きを再現。
description.en: • Reproduce Big Tony's comical and stylish movements with a wide range of motion.

description.ja: ■作中同様のビークルモードへの変形ギミックを組み替え式で再現。
description.en: • The transformation gimmick to the vehicle mode similar to the one in the work is reproduced by recombination.

description.ja: ■腕部はアンカーパーツを取り付けることで射出状態を再現可能。
description.en: • The arm part can reproduce the injection state by attaching anchor parts.

description.ja: ■マニピュレーターと掘削ドリルは組み替えで変更が可能。
description.en: • The manipulator and drilling drill can be changed by rearranging them.

description.ja: ■履帯はこだわりのディテールでリアル感を追求。
description.en: • The track pursues a realistic feel with careful details.

description.ja: ■アイシャッターとライトの蓋はパーツの差し替えで再現。
description.en: • The eye shutter and light lid can be recreated by replacing parts.
